review_text_raw:
It's not as good as I remembered it from watching YouTubers play it. The script is really weird and the AI just annoyed me. I am it and it is I! Mwah ha ha ha.
Shut up, I get it, you're some evil AI. 

I liked Taylor though, probably my favourite character up until he started going weird at the end. The fact that I liked some creepy guy who urinated in public over the main character... I know the game is supposed to be serious, but I can't take it seriously with the over the top glitches and script.

There was that one part where that one guy is messaging when the phone is glitching asking if I am safe. I don't think I am in danger unless the phone has an inbuilt explosive. 

Then at the very end it is implied that the AI can somehow destroy people mentally. Maybe the AI somehow tortured people by making them watch every episode of She Hulk. 

But what's this whole thing about the AI becoming one with people. I can just imagine people merging with electronics literally, like some cursed Cyriak or Meatcanyon video. MEAT POWER!
